mapper.select: SELECT sp.sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sp.sku_id AS skuId, sp.min_qty AS minQty, sp.max_qty AS maxQty, sp.price AS unitPrice FROM sku_price sp JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = sp.sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sp.sku_id, sp.min_qty
SELECT sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sku_id AS skuId, min_qty AS minQty, max_qty AS maxQty, price AS unitPrice FROM sku_price WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY min_qty
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_price (sku_id, min_qty, max_qty, price, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{minQty}, #{maxQty}, #{price}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sku_id AS skuId, min_qty AS minQty, max_qty AS maxQty, price AS unitPrice FROM sku_price WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND #{qty} BETWEEN min_qty AND max_qty ORDER BY min_qty DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sku_price_id AS skuPriceId, sku_id AS skuId, min_qty AS minQty, max_qty AS maxQty, price AS unitPrice, created_at AS createdAt FROM sku_price WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY min_qty
SELECT price FROM sku_price WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND #{qty} >= min_qty AND (max_qty IS NULL OR #{qty} <= max_qty ) ORDER BY min_qty DESC LIMIT 1
